title: Self-service storage facilities.
officialText:
Self-service storage facilities shall provide accessible individual self-storage spaces in compliance
with Section 1104 of this code and ICC A117.1, including Section 905 (Storage Facilities). The number of required self-storage spaces
shall be in accordance with Table 1108.3.
TABLE 1108.3
